title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The Emergency WASH Response for IDPs in North Kivu province project was designed to meet the acute needs of newly displaced people in Buhimba IDP camps around Goma city, displaced by the increase in fighting from M23 in North Kivu. The project distributed Water, Sanitation and Hygiene (WASH) kits to improve the hygiene and sanitation conditions of almost 19,000 IDPs. The project also provided Mental Health and Psychosocial Support (MHPSS), including counselling support groups and recreational activities for children to recover from trauma.. OVERALL COUNTRY PROG: Improved protection services and empowerment opportunities for the most vulnerable women and girls. SPECIFIC OUTCOME: The Emergency WASH Response for IDPs in North Kivu province supported the acute, immediate hygiene and sanitation needs of Internally Displaced People in Buhimba IDP camps around Goma city. The project distributed WASH kits including menstrual hygiene items and provided MHPSS activities and recreational activities for children, contributing to alleviate trauma, enhancing the wellbeing in the affected communities.
